evals.name: mcpp-rfp-win-themes
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. Build win-themes slice only: priority-ranked win_theme_candidates[] with rationale_chain, proof_required[], evaluation_factor_links[], and source_chunk_ids. Log missing theme evidence in claim_gaps[].
expectations: completes in under 120 seconds wall time
runs at most one kg_chunks pass per surface (shipley_needs_wants, shipley_win_themes)
does not call kg_chunks after retrieval_plan.json plan_complete is true
does not emit eval_crosswalk or customer_pain_points (sibling slices)
solo platform gate passes on win_themes_handoff.json

evals.name: honest-gaps-when-thin
evals.prompt: Sparse package. Emit best-effort win_theme_candidates for grounded themes; log ungrounded themes in claim_gaps[] by name.
evals.expected_output: Partial handoff plus explicit claim_gaps — no invented themes
expectations: claim_gaps[] names missing theme evidence when rows are thin
no scaffold themes with placeholder rationale_chain text

evals.name: retrieval-discipline-regression
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. One kg_entities + two kg_chunks (needs/wants then win themes), then draft without re-querying.
